Episode 260. Patriarch Succession Ceremony (1)
August 1st, 1805.

A crowd larger than ever before was flocking to the Garden of Swords. Runcandel had unprecedentedly opened the Garden of Swords completely, allowing anyone who came to watch the patriarch succession ceremony.
All the inns in Kalon had been full for several days, and countless tents had been set up in front of the Garden of Swords.
There were even crowds waiting for the patriarch succession ceremony from the sky, aboard the golden fleet of the Vamel Alliance. They were all ordinary citizens selected through a random lottery.
"Panda, eel, dried eel, eel skewers...!"

"Come on, come on, the Golden Pang Merchant Guild's new product experience zone is in that tent over there! Today, all items are specially discounted at half price, a groundbreaking opportunity that will never come again!"
The Golden Pang Merchant Guild had obtained the exclusive right to conduct commercial activities at this event and was passionately engaged in business every day.

"Ugh, hey! Where's your number one manager? Oh, there he is. You bastards, didn't I tell you I'd personally pick the best-drawn billboard with Jin-darling's face on it? Who told you to use a drawing like this?"
"Aah, it's Nodav Sarseng, run!"
"Run where? Where is there to run here?"
Thump!
Sandra lightly flicked Pang on the head. Dark Flame, who was next to him, also got hit for no reason.
"Why, me? Hit. Why...? I, panda, eel."
"It's called joint responsibility."
"Ah, ah."

Sandra grinned, bit Dark Flame's round head as if he were too cute to resist, and then snatched an eel skewer and put it in her mouth. Pang was about to kick Sandra in the shin but flinched upon seeing Hedo and let out a dry cough.
"Young Miss, that's enough interference with business for now."
"But I'm disappointed with Jin's face on the billboard. He's much more handsome than this, and to use a drawing like this on a day when so many people are watching."
"Still, in my eyes, this is excellent. It is a work of the God of Painters, Lord Keitam, so it's only natural."
As the world was restored, most gods had lost their physical forms. However, harmless gods like Keitam or Olmango were still living mixed in with human society or nature.
Hedo stroked his chin and looked at the giant billboards attached to each of the Golden Pang Merchant Guild's tents.
Jin, Veradin, Dante, Syris, Valeria, Sandra, Enya, Kashimir, etc... The Golden Pang Merchant Guild was using all the figures who could be called the pillars of the Vamel Alliance as free models.
"I am very pleased with my drawing. The virility of a man, the perfume of a male who knows style, Sarseng5."
"Puhaha, a male who knows style, he says. It's so cringey, really."
"Many men are actually following my fashion, Young Miss. It's called the so-called 'Hedo craze'."
"Yes, yes, Mr. Hedo Sarseng. I'm sure they are."

Sarseng. Hedo and Sandra had decided to abandon the Zipple surname and take on a new name just for the two of them. Hedo Sarseng, Sandra Sarseng. However, the two were always helping Veradin, and they were still a family.
Hedo was momentarily lost in reminiscence as he looked at the images of his comrades engraved on the billboards.

The days he had roamed the Black Sea like a beast, the 12th experimental facility of Zipple where he had met Sandra, the 2nd Magic Tower, and the Vamel Alliance and... the final battle with the Demon Army that had destroyed the world.
All those moments had flowed by like a dream, and he had finally reached this era. An era of peace, without any terrible wars.
Suddenly, someone linked arms with Hedo and came close.
"What are you thinking so hard about, stray cat? Hello to you too, Young Miss Sandra."
"Hello, Lord Vanessa!"

Sandra showed a particular favor towards Vanessa, who had married Hedo. Who on earth could this person live with in the future? Hedo and Sandra had always looked at each other and thought such things, so it was only natural.
"Ah, Vanessa. I was just thinking about the old days."
"The old days?"
"When I betrayed the Zipples and decided to join the Vamel Alliance... I had said this to Jin. That if I didn't see hope in Tikan, I would not hesitate to take the Young Miss and leave again."
"If the stray cat had left then, we wouldn't be able to see a scenery like this now. We wouldn't have been able to defeat the Demon Army."
"Was it that much?"

"If even one of those who fought in that battle had been missing, we would have definitely lost. Whether they were weak or strong, a Genesis Knight or not. It was thanks to everyone fighting while creating miracles every moment that the Young Patriarch was able to obtain the legacy."
"Well, I hate to admit that Hedo did well, but Lord Vanessa is right."
"And Sandra, you kept saving people while enduring the pain of your whole body burning then, didn't you?"
"If it's for Jin-darling, I can do even more than that, so, well."
"Hmm, it might be a good idea to start looking for someone else soon."
"Vanessa is great and all, but sometimes she gets on my nerves like this. I'm not meeting anyone but Jin. Red-hair... I'll snatch you away anytime. Kuhaha...!"
Hedo and Vanessa shook their heads from side to side.
And another group, watching them from about five or six steps away, was also shaking their heads.
"Bubar, even if you like this body, do not become like that."
"I pray the same for you too, Lord Ainas."
Bishukel, watching Bubar and Ainas flirting with each other, was seized by the impulse to send them off to some island just for the two of them forever. It was an impulse he felt every day.
Kinzelo.

Now, the third-rate terrorist group called Kinzelo had officially disappeared. The members of the former Kinzelo were now part of the Vamel Alliance, mainly in charge of tasks like marine rescue or forest fire suppression.
"Young Master Jin is finally becoming the patriarch, brother. It feels like just yesterday that I saw Young Master Jin collapse after his duel with you at the last banquet."
At Margiella's words, Bishukel let out a chuckle.
"Yes, you had asked me to get revenge, saying that Lord Jin had bullied our friend who was weaker than him... At that time, I had said this to myself."
"What was it?"
"Bubar is not weaker than Jin, and he is most certainly not our friend."
"Wow, do you still think so?"
"No. He's just a friend I don't want to see up close too often."
"What are you all talking about?"
"You're here, Leader?"
Orgal, the demons, and the beastmen approached the siblings' side.
"We were looking back on the old days. The day Lord Jin first appeared at the banquet."
"It's a pity I wasn't there then. I could have seen the young Jin before he became such a big shot."
Orgal now looked calm, his madness having subsided. He was spending his days being thankful that the numerous wars that had started from the error of the multiverse had finally ended.

The Sun God, a perfect world, he didn't even think about such things anymore. Now that the transcendent beings who tried to move the world as they pleased had all vanished, now that anyone, even if not a Genesis Knight, could overcome their destiny, was the most perfect and beautiful world.
"...Though belatedly, I realized what I truly wanted, and luckily, I was able to obtain it thanks to Jin and our comrades. I am a blessed person. Isn't that right, Zephyrin?"
"Well, I still find Lord Jin a little annoying, but... you're right."
"What do you mean, annoying? How dare you, to our brother. Are you crazy?"
It was Teto. The Plutonian members, who had just experienced the Golden Pang Merchant Guild's new products, were passing in front of the former Kinzelo members.
"Ah, I'm too scared to even speak. He can be a little annoying, right? We're comrades in arms, in a way. Can't I even say that much?"
"That's true, Teto. When I was drinking with her the other day, I thought I'd find him annoying too if I were her."
"I was just kidding around between comrades too, hehe. Are you scared, Zephyrin?"
"Scared... you're one to talk, being the weakest of the Battle Kings."
"What did you say!"
"That's enough, Brother Teto."
"Yes, Brother Battle God."
"Van, were you on your way to the inner court?"
"Yes, to meet Chiron. Want to come along?"
"Sounds good. You all look around."
The two, Orgal and Van, separated from the group and walked towards the inner court.
"You're here. Van, Orgal."
Chiron, Van, Talaris, Orgal, Ameris, Eltiot, Luna, Kashimir, Quicantel, Owl, Dante, Veradin, Lani, etc.

In the reception room of the inner court, those who could be called the adults, or giants, of the era had gathered and were talking. Ozdok and Jet were busily filling their wine glasses and teacups with refreshments from Litra Bakery and waiting on them.
"Lord Great Master Van's seat is over here!"
[Lord Orgal's seat is here!]
Chiron slowly looked around at those seated.
He felt a sense of reassurance.

"Runcandel, Zipple, Kinzelo. And the Secret Palace, the ancient hegemons, the Empire, the Holy Kingdom, and the nameless, all sitting in one place, asking after each other's well-being and enjoying refreshments..."
"Are you disappointed? That there are no fights."
"Are you disappointed that there are no fights, Van?"
"No."
"And yet you say such foolish things."

"This era of great peace will continue for at least a hundred years, no matter how short. It might even be longer than that. There are people among us who can live for more than a thousand years, and the desire to protect this era we've obtained with such difficulty will surely not change."

"Well, well... among the people here, there's only me and Quicantel. Are you saying we have to keep protecting it by ourselves after you all have returned to the earth? Huhu, of course, we have to. There are more of our long-lived comrades in other places than here. The one thing I don't want to experience again is the birth of another Kelliark."
Chiron nodded his head.

Hearts do not change. At least, those who had experienced that battle would be so. There would be those who would not die even after a hundred years, even after a thousand years, and would remember that battle.

"Of course, it won't be eternal, but it's true that this is the first time people have met such a peace since the beginning of history. Our Secret Palace will also be free from our duties and enjoy our freedom for a while. At least, I won't have to see any complicated and difficult situations anymore. Hmph, I don't know about our daughter, though. No, it's a peace that will surely be maintained until our children's era."
"You look to be in a good mood, Talaris."

"Of course I'm happy on a good day like this, would I be sad? Tch, I wanted to raise him as my son-in-law, but it's upsetting that he's becoming the patriarch of Runcandel in the end. Anyway, don't worry too much and pass the sword to Jin, Chiron."
At those words, Chiron gave a faint smile and replied.
"I have no worries. I am just a little disappointed."
